# Feature: Discovery Mode (`yantra do` / `discover`)

## 1. Feature Goal

**ID**: FEAT-020
**Source Plan**: `.spec-lite/plan_v2.md` (row FEAT-020; §4 DiscoverySession concept; §5 `yantra do` command; §6 "Discovery mode keeps the full envelope"; §7 "Discovery is a bounded sub-protocol in `packages/agent`"; §10 discovery trace)

`yantra do "see if tickets are available for the next NFL game near me"` — the agent works the **live web in real time** toward a goal it has no saved workflow for: propose a small next step, execute it through the deterministic engine, observe the (sanitized) result, re-plan; repeat under hard budgets until the goal is met, blocked, or exhausted. A successful path can be **promoted into a saved, replayable workflow** (`--save-as <name>`), and every `do` run emits a Brief documenting what happened and what was found.

Non-negotiables (plan §6/§7):

- **The executor stays a finite-plan walker.** Discovery proposes _bounded single-step (or few-step) plans_; each is schema+semantically validated and executed by the existing executor. No ReAct inside the engine.
- **The LLM never emits raw selectors.** Proposals reference targets via _semantic locator intents only_ (`role`, `label`, `text`, `placeholder`, `testid`); `css`/`xpath` kinds are rejected at validation for agent-proposed chains — locator resolution stays the engine's job.
- **Full security envelope**: secrets never reach the LLM (discovery has no secret access at all in this feature), every observation is sanitized before the model sees it, ethics gate non-bypassable, and **every mutating/critical action passes the FEAT-019 consent gateway**.
- **Hard caps**: `--max-steps` (default 15), token/cost budget, wall clock, and a per-session host allowlist (seeded by the goal's resolved domains, expandable only via a confirmation).

## 2. Data Model (Granular)

> No `.spec-lite/data_model.md` — designed here. Protocol sub-protocol types + per-session trace artifacts.

### Entities & Attributes

- **DiscoverySession** (protocol, `schemas/discovery.ts`):
  - `session_id` (ULID), `run_id` (string), `goal` (string, min 1),
  - `budget` ({ `max_steps`: int, `max_llm_calls`: int, `max_wall_clock_ms`: int, `max_cost_usd`: number | null }),
  - `host_allowlist` (string[]) — hard cap; grows only via confirmed expansion,
  - `cycles` (DiscoveryCycle[]), `outcome` (`'goal_met' | 'goal_unreachable' | 'budget_exhausted' | 'user_declined' | 'handoff' | 'aborted'`),
  - `promoted_workflow` (string | null) — workflow name if saved.
- **DiscoveryCycle** (one propose→act→observe turn):
  - `index` (int), `proposal` (DiscoveryProposal), `validation` (`'accepted' | 'rejected'` + reasons), `step_results` (existing StepResult summaries), `observation` (DiscoveryObservation), `budget_after` (snapshot).
- **DiscoveryProposal** (LLM output — untrusted, Zod-validated):
  - `rationale` (string, bounded len) — model's stated reasoning (audited, never executed),
  - `steps` (Step[], 1–3) — standard protocol steps; semantic-locator-only refinement; `requires_confirmation` auto-forced `true` on any mutating verb regardless of what the model set (defense in depth),
  - `done` ({ `goal_met`: boolean, `summary_md`: string, `citations_hint`: string[] } | null) — terminal claim, triggers Brief assembly.
- **DiscoveryObservation** (engine → model, **post-sanitizer**):
  - `url` (string), `title` (string | null),
  - `page_digest` (string, sanitized + truncated extract of readable content),
  - `interactables` (InteractableDescriptor[], ≤ 30) — `{ role, name, kind ('button'|'link'|'input'|'select'), disabled }` built by the existing injected-script descriptor machinery (no raw HTML, no attribute dumps beyond the sanitized descriptor),
  - `step_outcome` (`'completed' | 'failed' | 'ethics_refused' | 'confirmation_denied'` + typed reason).
- **Trace artifact**: `runs/<run-id>/discovery.jsonl` — one line per cycle (proposal, validation verdict, sanitized observation, budget) per plan §10; session summary in `manifest.json`.

### Relationships

- DiscoverySession 1:N DiscoveryCycle; 1:N ConfirmationRequest (via FEAT-019); 0..1 promoted WorkflowFile; 1:1 output Brief.
- Proposal.steps execute as ephemeral single-cycle `Plan`s through the standard executor (validated by the standard two-stage validation + discovery-specific refinements).

### Indexes & Constraints

- Host allowlist enforced _before_ the ethics gate (navigate to non-allowlisted host → blocked cycle observation, model may request expansion → surfaces as a ConfirmationRequest with `action_kind: 'navigate'`).
- `--dry-run`: mutating verbs are never executed — proposal validated, then reported; observation synthesizes "not executed (dry-run)".
- Bounded re-prompt on invalid proposals (max 2, memory convention), then `aborted` outcome with report.
- Scope is `public` for every observation sanitization; discovery cannot reference `SecretRef` at all (validation rejects) — authenticated discovery is explicitly out of scope (tracked in TODO).

## 3. Files

- `packages/protocol/src/schemas/discovery.ts` — session/cycle/proposal/observation schemas (+ events: `discovery_cycle_completed`, `discovery_session_completed`; additive 0.2).
- `packages/agent/src/discovery/propose.ts` — prompt assembly (goal + trimmed cycle history + latest observation → proposal), Zod parse, bounded re-prompt.
- `packages/agent/src/discovery/prompts.ts` — system prompt (tool-catalog subset: semantic locators + step verbs; consent + honesty rules stated).
- `packages/agent/src/discovery/session-state.ts` — pure state reducer (cycles, budget accounting, history trimming for context bounds).
- `packages/core/src/discovery/observe.ts` — observation builder: current page → Readability digest → `sanitize()` → interactable descriptors via injected script.
- `packages/core/src/discovery/promote.ts` — successful trace → `WorkflowFile` (steps + named locator chains from the _engine-resolved_ winning candidates, params extracted from goal literals), lint-clean output via existing YAML emitter.
- `apps/cli/src/commands/do.ts` — the driver loop (CLI composes agent + core; respects the agent-must-not-import-core boundary): propose (agent) → validate → confirm-if-needed (FEAT-019 gateway) → execute (core executor) → observe (core) → repeat; flags `--dry-run`, `--save-as`, `--max-steps`, `--budget`, `--yes-to nothing` (parse-level: only accepted value, documents that nothing can be auto-granted).
- `apps/cli/src/index.ts` — register `do` + `discover` alias.
- Tests: `packages/agent/tests/discovery/`, `packages/core/tests/discovery/`, `e2e/discovery.spec.ts` (fixture site), chaos additions.

## 4. Dependencies

- **FEAT-019** (consent gateway) — hard prerequisite (plan: FEAT-019 → FEAT-020 strictly sequential).
- **FEAT-013/014/015** — Brief output of a `do` run (final `done.summary_md` + trace → synthesized Brief with visited-page sources).
- **FEAT-016** — optional first cycle may issue a search (registry provider) to find entry-point URLs; soft dep.
- Existing: executor + two-stage validation, locator engine descriptors, sanitizer, `LLMClient` + audit, ethics gate, YAML emitter + lint.

## 6. Cross-Cutting Concerns

- **Auth**: no authenticated discovery in this feature — `SecretRef` rejected at validation; logged-in flows remain the recorded-workflow path (TODO entry added for authenticated discovery as a future feature).
- **Error Handling**: every cycle failure becomes an observation the model can react to (retry/fallback) under budget; terminal failures produce `report.md` + typed outcome; consent denial is exit 4, not an error.
- **Logging**: `discovery.jsonl` per cycle (sanitized observation, proposal, verdict, budget) per plan §10; LLM calls to `agent.jsonl` with cost; confirmations to their FEAT-019 trails; `yantra audit` extended to narrate cycles + consent decisions.
- **Security**: full envelope per plan §6 — sanitizer chokepoint on observations, semantic-locators-only, consent on every mutating action (type-forced + executor-gated), host allowlist hard cap, ethics gate untouched, honest blocking (a bot-blocked page is an observation stating so; the model must route around or hand off, never evade).

## 8. Known Limitations (see DEVIATION notes on TASK-004/005)

Two structural gaps constrain what discovery mode can actually do against a live site today, **neither introduced by this feature** — both are pre-existing gaps in the executor/locator wiring that also affect `yantra run`:

1. **No real `InjectedScriptHost` wiring.** `click`/`fill`/`extract`/`wait_for`/`assert` step handlers all require one and error without it; no production code path anywhere constructs one from a live page. Only `navigate` works against a real browser today.
2. **`RunOrchestrator` never wires a `ConfirmationGateway`.** Every confirmable step in `yantra run`/`yantra resume` fails closed today. `do.ts` works around this by driving the `Executor` directly with its own `InteractiveConfirmationGateway`, bypassing `RunOrchestrator`.

Both are tracked as pre-existing-gap items in `.spec-lite/TODO.md`, separate from FEAT-020's own deferred enhancements (allowlist-expansion-via-confirmation, entry-point search, param-prompting during promotion).
